notes: Counts active descriptors separately from playing descriptors; this fixture has eight live descriptors and four in CON_PLAYING.
Session fanout provider excludes menu, creation, OLC and linkless while retaining PLR_WRITING recipients for callers that apply their own writing gate.
The callback only heals the actor and playing recipient; menu, editor, and linkless bodies keep their HP.
Real REDIT/TEDIT entries leave the descriptor non-playing; real clean/abort exits restore playing eligibility without changing PLR_WRITING semantics.
Under -race, concurrent menu and PC-switch transitions preserve the descriptor-state snapshot without taking playerLifecycleMu.
